name: Generate Typing SVG from Source

on:
  schedule:
    # Berjalan setiap 5 menit
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # Tombol untuk menjalankan manual dari tab Actions
  push:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/typing.yml"

jobs:
  build-svg:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write # Izin agar bot bisa commit file ke repo

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository (Repo Kamu)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Typing SVG Engine (Repo Asli DenverCoder1)
        # Kita clone source code PHP-nya ke folder lokal "typing-engine"
        run: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/DenverCoder1/readme-typing-svg.git typing-engine

      - name: Setup PHP Environment
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.2'
          tools: composer:v2

      - name: Install Engine Dependencies
        run: |
          cd typing-engine
          composer install --no-dev --no-interaction --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader

      - name: Generate SVG Offline
        run: |
          cat <<'EOF' > generate.php
          <?php
          declare(strict_types=1);
          // Load autoloader dari engine PHP yang sudah di-clone
          require __DIR__ . '/typing-engine/vendor/autoload.php';

          // ⚙️ PARAMETER KHUSUS NURUDDIN RUSYDI ILHAM
          $params = [
              'font'      => 'Fira Code',
              'weight'    => '600',
              'size'      => '35',
              'duration'  => '3000',
              'pause'     => '1000',
              'color'     => '00FFAA',
              'center'    => 'true',
              'vCenter'   => 'true',
              'width'     => '800',
              'lines'     => 'Hi, I\'m Nuruddin Rusydi Ilham 👋;Backend & Network Engineering;Linux Infrastructure & Automation;DNS Filtering & Security Builder.'
          ];

          // Panggil class Controller dari repo aslinya
          $controller = new RendererController($params);
          
          // Simpan hasil render ke folder dist
          if (!is_dir('dist')) { mkdir('dist', 0777, true); }
          file_put_contents('dist/typing.svg', $controller->render());
          
          echo "✅ SVG berhasil digenerate 100% dari source code!";
          EOF
          
          # Jalankan script PHP di atas
          php generate.php

      - name: Add Timestamp to force commit
        run: |
          # Tambahkan timestamp agar selalu terdeteksi sebagai "perubahan" oleh git
          echo "<!-- generated: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) -->" >> $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist/typing.svg

      - name: Commit & Push
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "RusdiEneri"
          git config user.email "nuruddinrusydiilham@gmail.com"
          
          cd $GITHUB_WORKSPACE
          git add dist/typing.svg
          
          # Karena ada timestamp di baris akhir, diff TIDAK akan pernah kosong (quiet)
          # Jadi commit akan selalu dieksekusi setiap 5 menit
          git commit -m "chore: update typing svg (forced update) [skip ci]"
          
          # Pull rebase untuk menghindari konflik jika ada perubahan manual di repo
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin HEAD:main
